sinopsis.es: Machado, colombiano radicado en Francia, regresa a Medellín para robar una esmeralda. Mientras ejecuta el plan, se enreda en una serie de eventos que lo llevan a reconsiderar su misión.
sinopsis.en: Machado, a Colombian living in France, returns to Medellín to steal an emerald. As he executes his plan, he becomes entangled in a series of events that force him to reconsider his mission.
